# swarm-test

Used to demonstrate zero-downtime deploys with Dokploy.

Use STARTUP_DELAY environment variable to modify the startup delay of the service.

Referenced in: https://docs.dokploy.com/docs/core/applications/zero-downtime

FROM node:20-slim AS base
ENV PNPM_HOME="/pnpm"
ENV PATH="$PNPM_HOME:$PATH"
RUN corepack enable
COPY . /app
WORKDIR /app

## Install curl
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl

FROM base AS prod-deps
RUN pnpm install --prod --frozen-lockfile

FROM base AS build
RUN pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
RUN pnpm run build

FROM base
COPY --from=prod-deps /app/node_modules /app/node_modules
EXPOSE 3000
CMD [ "pnpm", "start" ]
